postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve exactly four digits, including leading zeroes. Structure alone does not prove that Australia Post currently allocates a code.
postal_system.delivery_category_rule: Keep Delivery Area, Post Office Boxes, large-volume receiver, specialist delivery and other Australia Post classifications distinct; a non-street-delivery code is non-areal unless operator evidence states otherwise.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Australia Post postcode contours are not public authoritative boundaries. An ABS Postal Area is a Mesh Block approximation and any surface derived from G-NAF points is noncanonical derived_geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: G-NAF supplies authoritative public address identity and geocode evidence, but its postcode may be locality-derived and its licence requires a secondary source before using an address for sending mail.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires a pinned Geoscape building_address relationship or reviewed explicit crosswalk. Containment and nearest-footprint joins remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: State, territory, LGA and locality context cannot create or clip an Australia Post assignment; postcode areas may cross state boundaries.
postal_system.territory_rule: Christmas Island, Cocos (Keeling) Islands and Norfolk Island remain separate CX, CC and NF country packs even when upstream Australian datasets cover them.

exception_classes.rule: Use Australia Post evidence for allocation and category; use only a separately classified official-derived or derived geometry artifact for display.
Return facility or routing context without inventing a surrounding residential polygon, premise or building.
Treat Parcel Locker and Parcel Collect as delivery endpoints; never expose customer identifiers or infer residence.
Preserve organisation or specialist routing semantics and keep the record non-areal by default.
Label ASGS POA geometry official-derived statistical approximation, pin the ASGS edition and never call it an Australia Post boundary.
Retain G-NAF postcode lineage and require Australia Post or another permitted secondary source for mailing or deliverability use.
Partition CX, CC and NF before ingesting G-NAF, ABS, Geoscape or Australia Post records into the AU pack.
Version postcode allocation, address lifecycle, POA, buildings, crosswalks and administrative boundaries with separate valid and known times.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release, digest, terms reference, attribution, geographic scope, transformation method and rights partition.
Australia Post assignment, ABS POA approximation, G-NAF-derived surfaces, address points, buildings, administrative context and AGID covers remain independent evidence.
Any mailing use has recorded secondary verification; public lookup does not claim G-NAF alone proves mail receipt or deliverability.
A displayed building has one coherent identifier-backed path; containment or nearest matches remain derived candidates with ambiguity.
Geometry is valid, edition-pinned, bounded and explicitly excludes non-street-delivery classes not represented by POA.
No recipient, resident, owner, customer, change-of-address, delivery instruction, credential, private unit or contract-restricted row is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, coverage and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
